summary: Luda Technology Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of Ms. Liu Liangping as a Director of the Board, effective June 18, 2026. Ms. Liu resigned to focus on the Company's merger and acquisition projects, and her resignation is not due to any disagreement with the Company or Board. She will remain as Chief Operating Officer and hold other subsidiary positions. No specific deal terms are disclosed. This is a routine management change with no special-situation financial transaction. Standard insider transition note; no risk-arb angle.
